releases.notes:
### Changelog:

**Changes:**

- The following blocks can now be used in the “alternative stones” recipes:
  - Smooth Stone
  - Mossy Cobblestone
  - Stone Bricks
  - Cracked Stone Bricks
  - Chiseled Stone Bricks
  - Mossy Stone Bricks
  - Polished Andesite
  - Polished Diorite
  - Polished Granite
  - Deepslate Bricks
  - Cracked Deepslate Bricks
  - Polished Deepslate
  - Chiseled Deepslate
  - Deepslate Tiles
  - Cracked Deepslate Tiles
  - Tuff Bricks
  - Polished Tuff
  - Chiseled Tuff
  - Chiseled Tuff Bricks
  - Polished Blackstone
  - Polished Blackstone Bricks
  - Cracked Polished Blackstone Bricks
  - Chiseled Polished Blackstone
  - End Stone Bricks

![image](https://i.imgur.com/3QCMPig.png)

![image](https://i.imgur.com/t3Ioz2p.png)

- All Smithing Template duplication recipes are now shapeless
  - Items can be placed anywhere in the crafting grid

![image](https://i.imgur.com/TwhyKRb.png)

**Technical Changes:**

- Bumped max supported pack format to 82 for Java Snapshot 25w31a
- Alphabetised `#crafting:alternative_stones` & `#crafting:alternative_stone_slabs` item tags
- Added `#minecraft:copper_blocks` item tag
  - Allows Waxed Copper Blocks to be used in the new shapeless Bolt Armor Trim Smithing Template duplication recipe
- Updated `pack.mcmeta` to support new 25w31a pack format system

### Known Issues:

- In 25w31a, a "broken or incompatible" error is displayed when selecting the data pack in the New World screen
  - The pack _should_ still work though.

### Compatibility:

- Minecraft Java 1.21.6 - 1.21.8
- Snapshot 25w31a (data pack only)
- Fabric & Quilt:
  - [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) for 1.21.6 - 1.21.8
- NeoForge:
  - 21.6.0+ for 1.21.6
  - 21.7.0+ for 1.21.7
  - 21.8.0+ for 1.21.8
- Forge:
  - 56.0.0+ for 1.21.6
  - 57.0.0+ for 1.21.7
  - 58.0.0+ for 1.21.8

### Support:

Please report any issues or submit any feature requests on [GitHub](https://github.com/Classic36-Media/Better-Craftables/issues) or [Discord](https://discord.gg/vZJSDjPcmu).

>[!TIP]
> .jar = Fabric/Quilt mod & Forge/NeoForge mod
> .zip = Data pack

releases.notes:
### Changelog:

**New Features:**

- Added Sandstone dyeing recipes
  - Combine any Sandstone block with Red Dye to craft its Red Sandstone variant
  - Combine any Red Sandstone block with Yellow Dye to craft its regular Sandstone variant
  - Applies to:
    - (Red) Sand
    - (Red) Sandstone
    - (Red) Sandstone Stairs
    - (Red) Sandstone Slabs
    - (Red) Sandstone Walls
    - Smooth (Red) Sandstone
    - Smooth (Red) Sandstone Stairs
    - Smooth (Red) Sandstone Slabs
    - Cut (Red) Sandstone
    - Cut (Red) Sandstone Slabs
    - Chiseled (Red) Sandstone

![image](https://i.imgur.com/9vM3Ego.png)
![image](https://i.imgur.com/TLJkuoF.png)

**Changes:**

- Updated pack description & file name to include Java 1.21.8

**Technical Changes:**

- [Mod] Now explicitly depends on Minecraft Java 1.21.6 - 1.21.8
   - Previously, the mod was marked as compatible with 1.21.6 and all future versions, which could cause issues with untested future game updates.

### Compatibility:

- Minecraft Java 1.21.6 - 1.21.8
- Fabric & Quilt with [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) for 1.21.6 - 1.21.8
- NeoForge:
  - for 1.21.6: 21.6.0 or newer
  - for 1.21.7: 21.7.0 or newer
  - for 1.21.8: 21.8.0 or newer
- Forge:
  - for 1.21.6: 56.0.0 or newer
  - for 1.21.7: 57.0.0 or newer
  - for 1.21.8: 58.0.0 or newer

### Support:

Please report any issues or submit any feature requests on [GitHub](https://github.com/Classic36-Media/Better-Craftables/issues) or [Discord](https://discord.gg/vZJSDjPcmu).

>[!TIP]
> .jar = Fabric/Quilt mod & Forge/NeoForge mod
> .zip = Data pack

### Changelog:

**New Features:**

- Added 112 new redyeing recipes (based on “Universal Dyeing” by [Vanilla Tweaks](https://vanillatweaks.net/))
  - Dye almost any dyeable block to another colour, no matter which colour you have!
  - Currently applies the following blocks:
    - Candles
    - Concrete Powder
    - Concrete (not included in Vanilla Tweaks)
    - Glazed Terracotta
    - Stained Glass Panes
    - Stained Glass
    - Terracotta

![image](https://i.imgur.com/O4oKIIS.png)

![image](https://i.imgur.com/00pp8O6.png)

- Updated credits.txt

**Technical Changes:**

- Added item tags for the above redyeing blocks

releases.notes:
### Changelog:

- Bumped max supported pack format to 77
- Updated credits.txt
- Added additional item requirement triggers for recipe unlocks
  - Recipes now unlock when you have all of the required items for that recipe, instead of just one.
- End Stone can now be used in alternative stone recipes

![image](https://i.imgur.com/CM93KXH.png)

- End Stone Brick Slabs can now be used in alternative stone slab recipes

![image](https://i.imgur.com/Cf588zV.png)

- Added crafting recipes for all Coral Blocks, using a 2x2 arrangement of each block's respective Fans and/or Tubes

![image](https://i.imgur.com/Incq7Ng.png)

- Added an alternative bow crafting recipe
  - A common recipe mistake will finally work!

![image](https://i.imgur.com/YNNiauM.png)

- Made the Name Tag recipe cheaper ([#9](https://github.com/Classic36-Media/Better-Craftables/issues/9))
  - Now requires 2 Iron Nuggets instead of Iron Ingots

![image](https://i.imgur.com/p43FYIN.png)

### Compatibility:

**Data Pack:**
- Minecraft Java 1.21.5
- Snapshots 25w15a - 25w19a

**Mod:**
- Fabric & Quilt with [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) for 1.21.5
- NeoForge 21.5.0 or newer for 1.21.5
- Forge 55.0.0 or newer for 1.21.5

### Support:

Please report any issues or submit any feature requests on [GitHub](https://github.com/Classic36-Media/Better-Craftables/issues) or [Discord](https://discord.gg/vZJSDjPcmu).

>[!TIP]
> .jar = Fabric/Quilt mod & Forge/NeoForge mod
> .zip = Data pack
